niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with strong visual clarity, spacious spacing, and simplified structure. They often favor light neutral backgrounds with dark text, soft grayscale surfaces, and restrained decoration, though they sometimes also respond positively to premium dark navy/black themes when paired with high contrast and clear hierarchy. Across screens, they repeatedly choose layouts with more breathing room, fewer competing controls, clearer section separation, stronger content hierarchy, rounded cards or modals, and concise copy. They also prefer obvious primary actions, organized card-based grouping, and reduced visual clutter over dense, busy, or overly fragmented presentations.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds with dark readable text and subtle accents most often; in some cases also likes dark navy/black themes when they feel premium and maintain strong contrast.
Prefers spacious, open layouts with generous whitespace, larger gaps, and fewer tightly packed elements rather than dense or crowded screens.
Prefers streamlined screens with fewer visible controls, fewer competing metrics, and simpler content presentation over information-heavy or overly instrumented interfaces.
Prefers clear hierarchy with prominent titles, labeled sections, distinct grouping, summary cards, and content that is easy to scan.
Prefers minimal decorative overlays, fewer floating elements, softer emphasis, and cleaner compositions instead of flashy, busy, or overlapping visuals.
Prefers a clearly prioritized primary action, often as a dominant filled button or obvious action area, with secondary actions visually subdued but still accessible.
Prefers softer rounded corners, pill-shaped buttons, cushioned cards, and gentler container styling over square or sharp-edged components.
